blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr. on Friday maintained that his remarks about the Senate impeachment court were constitutionally protected, citing Supreme Court rulings on freedom of expression and the public’s right to criticize judicial authorities. Panelo’s statement came after the Senate Impeachment Court ordered the issuance of a show cause order (SCO), requiring him to explain why he should not be cited for contempt over his remarks accusing some senator-judges of bias against Duterte.
